hotels.title: Nusa Penida's Only Five-Star Eco-Retreat with Daily Breakfast, Nightly Dinner & Bali Return Boat Transfers
hotels.description: Integrated into the volcanic cliffs of Gamat Bay, Māua Nusa Penida is the island's first and only five-star eco-retreat, where sweeping views of the ocean and Mount Agung frame every sunrise and sunset. Built from local limestone with clean modernist lines and Wabi-Sabi-inspired interiors, the resort is designed to age beautifully alongside the rugged island it calls home. Drawing on more than 15 local micro farms, KŌWHAI Restaurant's hyper-local menu is a tribute to Nusa Penida's seasonal rhythms, while Aroha Bar brings the same thoughtfulness to its cocktail list. Pounamu Wellness & Spa offers Balinese and Javanese massages in open-air spaces that welcome the forest breeze, and an infinity pool overlooking the bay invites endless lounging. Beyond the resort, the island's dramatic landscape rewards exploration. Crystal Bay is close by for snorkelling with manta rays, Klingking Beach delivers dreamy coastal views and Angel Billabong is accessible for a full day out. Sunrise yoga sessions and traditional wooden boat journeys to the island's most iconic vistas are available to book on site.
